## Services
- Tree Removal — safe takedowns near structures, residential and commercial.
- Tree Trimming & Pruning — health, clearance, view, and storm prep.
- Stump Grinding — grind below grade so you can re-plant or pave.
- Stump Removal — full root-ball excavation when grinding isn't enough.
- Land Clearing — selective or full clear for development, pasture, or homesite.
- Excavation — site prep, foundations, drainage, ponds.
- Dirt Work — grading, fill, pad building, driveway base.
- Storm Cleanup — emergency tree-on-structure response and debris haul.
- Storm Shelter / Cellar Installation — NEW. In-ground shelter set, excavation through backfill.

## Free Estimates
We provide free on-site estimates and reply during business hours, usually within the hour.
